excluded_features.news_mean_sentiment: Phase 33 Walk-Forward DM test p=0.58; zero incremental Sharpe in mega-caps where headline news is priced in milliseconds by HFT participants.
excluded_features.earnings_overall_sentiment: Quarterly publication is too sparse to produce continuous alpha; bootstrap Sharpe 95% CI spanned zero across all tested walk-forward folds.
excluded_features.earnings_prepared_sentiment: Scripted and sanitized by IR and corporate legal counsel; exhibits zero correlation with post-earnings announcement drift.
excluded_features.earnings_qa_sentiment: High variance across single quarters; redundant with realized volatility jumps around earnings dates.
excluded_features.earnings_qa_vs_prepared_delta: Sparse single-stock signal that fails to generalize to index ETFs (SPY) and degrades cross-asset model stability.
excluded_features.earnings_linguistic_uncertainty: Highly collinear with realized volatility (vol_20d) and ATR (VIF > 8.0); adds redundant variance without incremental information.
